intro: Following the trail of a missing dwarven siege engine pilot leads to a frozen corpse in the wilds of Dun Morogh. Found among the remains, Hildelve's personal journal details his fatal struggle against a notorious predator known as Mangeclaw, leaving behind a dying wish for vengeance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear." He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.
Judging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.
However, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is grim news, for Hildelve was a good friend. And I wish I could have been there with you when you found the beast, Mangeclaw!
Thank you, friend. Your deed will be remembered by the pilots of the Ironforge Siege Brigade.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
